errors.text_span: 在x轴从1到30的变化过程中，该线的值从70.5开始，经历波动，在第2个模型达到峰值71.2，然后下降到第3个模型的69.8，接着再次波动上升到第5个模型的70.8，随后在第8个模型下降到69.7，在第12个模型达到70.8，在第18个模型下降到69.7，在第19个模型达到70.6，最终在第30个模型下降到69.7。
errors.evidence: The description provides an excessive, point-by-point recitation of the values of the solid line, which is difficult to read and does not effectively summarize the line's behavior. A general description of the fluctuation and range would be more appropriate.

The description states that the solid line starts at a value of 70.5. However, the chart shows the solid line starting at a value slightly below the dotted line (which is at 70.5), approximately at 70.3.
The description identifies the dotted line as black, but in the figure, all three lines are the same shade of grey.
